## Notes

- Memorial and sympathy templates are monochrome (accent saturation ≤ 0.25) and use
  the quietest opening scene (`minimal-editorial`) with no confetti, balloons,
  starburst or ribbon ornaments.
- Pchum Ben, Kathina, merit, get-well, longevity, blessings and housewarming use the
  quietest or soft reveal and carry no celebratory motifs; their accents are muted
  golds, greens and earth tones, not party colours.
- No template contains a Buddha image, monk figure, robe depiction, relic or deity.
  Lotus, kbach ornament, candle, abstract temple silhouette and the sun medallion are
  the only symbolic artwork, and all are procedural SVGs.
- Every name, date, time and venue is a bracketed placeholder; the phone-number and
  email scans return nothing, and no template carries emoji.
- Weddings use either the formal or the short invitation register, never both in one
  template; a Khmer string is never replaced by English to make a fit.
